title: Kenyan Indigenous Games
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Tagging games on grass; songs for rhythm. Safe touching only.

skills.key_step: The child describes indigenous tagging games: a chaser tags with a light touch, the tagged runner becomes the chaser, and the games build speed, agility and teamwork.

floor.prerequisite: Names rope games and their benefits (Grade 7).
floor.question: What does skipping build?

misconceptions.ask: What happens when the chaser touches a runner?
misconceptions.repair: Play one round: the touched runner becomes the chaser.
Feel the heartbeat after a tag game.
Ask: does someone chase and touch?

misconceptions.ask: How should a chaser tag a runner?
misconceptions.repair: Practise a gentle touch on the shoulder.
